column1:

column1: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.
column2: 训练有素的心灵孕育有序的思想。

column1: A throne is the most devious trap of them all
column2: 王座是所有陷阱中最阴险的一个。

column1:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.
column2:
传说：A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

column1: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
column2: 万事皆需平衡，魔法领域尤其如此。

column1: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.
column2: 战斗中铸成的纽带胜过血缘。

column1: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
column2: 燃烧灵魂，以活化血肉。

column1: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.
column2: 每一道伤口都让死亡更近一步。

column1:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
column2:
传说：Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.

column1: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
column2: 为追求伟大舍弃一切，甚至生命本身。

column1: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
column2: 伟大的战术家明白，稳定往往胜过潜力。

column1: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.
column2: 希望是错误。痛苦才是唯一真理。

column1: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
column2: 我给予你们一切，我的宠物们。别让我失望。

column1: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
column2: 战斗中，确定性值得付出些许痛苦。

column1: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
column2: 割开血脉，从洒落的生命中汲取力量。

column1:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.
column2:
传说：Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.

column1:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
column2:
传说：My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.

column1: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.
column2: 心跳漏拍，屏住呼吸。毒太慢时，唯有死亡。

column1:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
column2:
传说：Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.

column1: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.
column2: 力量带来敬畏。没有比这更简单的法则。

column1: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.
column2: 撕裂我的血肉，粉碎我的骨骼。你永远无法折断我的意志。

column1: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.
column2: 身体是一件等待被掌握的武器。

column1: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
column2: 人数越少，需要分享的就越少。

column1: The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.
column2: 荒野不可遏止的灵魂在你体内燃烧，咆哮着渴望释放。

column1: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.
column2: 音符或许改变，旋律始终如一。

column1: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.
column2: 泰坦并未从世界消失。他们的伟力仍在你体内延续。

column1:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...
column2:
传说：The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...

column1: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!
column2: 到我身边来，勇敢的同伴！感受我的光辉流经你们！

column1: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
column2: 对防御的绝对信任会释放终极潜能。

column1:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?
column2:
传说：What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?

column1: While the mind endures, so too will the body.
column2: 只要心智坚持，身体亦会支撑。

column1: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?
column2: 我为何要闪避我并不畏惧的打击？

column1: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
column2: 你怀着敌意绕行黑蝎，一次又一次挑衅它。

column1: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
column2: 你的孙辈会因我今日所言的记忆而尖叫着醒来。
